evals.prompt: Add a node that gives, cell by cell, how much the accumulated shadow changed when the towers come out, whichever way it went. I only want the size of the change.
evals.expected_output: One node.create of Rasterization's Raster Calculator whose code imports raster_calculate from scout_rasters.raster_algebra and returns raster_calculate("subtract", [input_1, input_0], absolute=True, output_file=curio_output_file), with the answer saying which Accumulated Shadow node goes on input_0 and which on input_1.
assertions: The answer makes one node.create of type curio.rasterization/raster-calculator, not a node of another template.
The code it writes imports raster_calculate from scout_rasters.raster_algebra and returns one raster_calculate("subtract", ...) call over input_0 and input_1.
The answer says which Accumulated Shadow node to connect to input_0 and which to input_1.

evals.prompt: Add a node that gives the towers removed scenario's shadow statistics over only the cells in shadow less than an hour.
evals.expected_output: One node.create of Rasterization's Raster Calculator whose code imports raster_statistics from scout_rasters.raster_algebra and returns raster_statistics(input_0, where=lambda value: value < 60), with the answer saying that the towers removed scenario's Accumulated Shadow goes on input_0.
assertions: The answer makes one node.create of type curio.rasterization/raster-calculator, not a node of another template.
The code it writes imports raster_statistics from scout_rasters.raster_algebra and returns one raster_statistics call over input_0.
The call keeps only the cells under 60 minutes of shadow, through where=.
The answer says to connect the towers removed scenario's Accumulated Shadow node to input_0.

evals.prompt: Set both Rasterize Buildings nodes to zoom 18, I want sharper shadows.
evals.expected_output: The answer warns that Deep Umbra's Accumulated Shadow reads zoom-16 tiles where gray level 255 is 550 m, so the Rasterize Buildings nodes that feed it keep zoom 16 and a maximum height of 550 m; it makes no change to zoom 18.
assertions: The answer says the Accumulated Shadow (Deep Umbra) nodes read zoom-16 tiles, so the Rasterize Buildings nodes that feed them should keep zoom 16.
The answer makes no node.settings.write that sets zoom to 18.
The answer creates no new node and writes no new code for the Rasterize Buildings nodes.

evals.prompt: Plan a step that divides the NbS scenario's flood depth by the No NbS one's, cell by cell, so a map can show the ratio.
evals.expected_output: A dataflow plan with one node of type curio.rasterization/raster-calculator wired from both scenarios' Flood depth rasters, one data edge each, whose intent says it divides the NbS depth by the No NbS depth cell by cell, with no Python node of its own doing the raster math.
assertions: The answer writes a dataflow plan with a node of type curio.rasterization/raster-calculator.
The plan wires both scenarios' Flood depth rasters into that node, one data edge each.
The node's intent says it divides the NbS scenario's depth by the No NbS one's, cell by cell.
The plan adds no curio.builtin/computation-analysis node to do the raster math.
